name: Limit Identification 8
definition: Defines the identification details to uniquely identify a limit within the system.

SystemIdentification.name: System Identification
SystemIdentification.definition: Identification of a particular cash clearing system.

BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification.name: Bilateral Limit Counterparty Identification
BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification.definition: Identification of the system member for which the limit is established.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of the risk management limit.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Owner of the account which is being queried.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

BilateralLimitCounterparty1Rule.definition: If Type is MULT, then BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is not allowed.

BilateralLimitCounterparty2Rule.definition: If Type is BILI or NELI or INBI, then BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification must be present.
